name: Physical Infrastructure and Property
blurb: Property cover on the buildings themselves. Liquid cooling leaks, transformer and substation failures under sudden AI load, battery storage fire risk, structural floor loading on racks above 100 kW, water use and environmental impairment, small modular reactor co-location, physical sabotage, and how reinsurers price site selection.

points.desc: Liquid-related damage accounts for close to a quarter of data centre loss costs across fifteen years, per Swiss Re. Direct-to-chip cooling put fluid inside the rack next to energised equipment, and FM added a liquid-cooling section to its 2026 loss prevention guidance.
points.name: Direct-to-chip liquid cooling leaks

points.desc: Property cover for high voltage failures caused by sudden AI workload spikes.
points.name: Substation and transformer overheating

points.desc: Premium increases and refusals for campuses built in fire or flood exposed regions.
points.name: Wildfire and catastrophe coverage gaps

points.desc: Liability and property exposure on mega scale battery installations used for backup and off grid power.
points.name: Battery energy storage fire risk

points.desc: Regulatory and legal cover where operations deplete local aquifers or discharge heated water.
points.name: Water use and environmental impairment

points.desc: Property implications of retrofitting legacy buildings for racks exceeding 100 kW.
points.name: Structural floor loading

points.desc: Equipment breakdown claims from continuous maximum load operation through extreme heat.
points.name: HVAC and chiller breakdown

points.desc: Insurance frameworks for facilities connected directly to micro reactors.
points.name: Small modular reactor co-location

points.desc: No longer hypothetical. Drone strikes on three AWS facilities in the UAE and Bahrain in March 2026 moved geopolitical exclusion review from a theoretical underwriting question to a live one for Gulf-region operators, and the same wording reaches any site near contested airspace.
points.name: Physical sabotage and drone threats

points.desc: How reinsurers price seismic, coastal surge and grid vulnerability by geography.
points.name: Reinsurance site selection maps
